summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 27, 2026 it, subsidiary RedCloud Technologies Limited, and Saudi Arabia's MJM AlKhaleej L.L.C. entered a shareholders agreement and a twenty-year platform license and infrastructure usage agreement to form a Saudi/Bahrain joint venture operating RedAI intelligent trade infrastructure. Ownership is 51%/49% RedCloud UK/MJM, with the JV to be incorporated in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province. Licensing charges are capped at 10% of eligible collected revenue per customer order. No price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation stated; watch JV incorporation and deployment risk.
